name: nexa-ai-local-bridge
description: Secure Windows companion for Nexa AI Computer Bridge with Hostinger Unity mirroring plus GitHub Remote Workspace read/write workflow for ChatGPT Plus.
author: Nexa

scripts.validate: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/services/bridge-client.js && node --check src/services/workspace-client.js && node --check src/services/unity-workspace.js && node --check src/services/github-workspace.js && node --check src/services/secure-config.js && node --check src/services/system-info.js && node --check src/services/policy.js && node --check src/services/logger.js && node --check src/services/read-only-executor.js && npm run validate:delivery && npm run validate:project && npm test
scripts.build:win: npm run validate && electron-builder --win nsis portable zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run validate && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.build:mac: npm run validate && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.test: npm run test:baseline && npm run test:implementation && npm run test:acceptance
